name: altium-mcp
description: Altium Designer integration server providing PCB and schematic design automation tools through MCP

tools.name: get_output_job_containers
tools.description: List the output containers of an OutJob file (outjob_path, or the first open OutJob)

tools.name: run_output_jobs
tools.description: Run output job containers from an OutJob file (outjob_path, or the first open OutJob) and check that PDF containers wrote their file

tools.name: get_outjob_settings
tools.description: Read an .OutJob file from disk and return containers, outputs and decoded fabrication settings (Gerber layers, NC Drill, IPC-D-356, pick and place)

tools.name: get_project_info
tools.description: Get the focused project's parameters, documents with unsaved-changes state, sheet count and variants

tools.name: get_project_components
tools.description: List every component of the compiled project with comment, footprint, library reference, sheet and optional parameters

tools.name: get_erc_violations
tools.description: Compile a project (the focused one, or one by path) in memory and list ERC/compiler violations by level

tools.name: get_board_summary
tools.description: Summarise the focused PCB: outline, origin, dimensions, vias by hole size, components per side, primitives per layer and overlay texts

tools.name: get_component_primitives
tools.description: List the primitives of PCB components with their layers and pad mask expansions

tools.name: get_all_designators
tools.description: Get all component designators from the current Altium board

tools.name: get_all_component_property_names
tools.description: Get all available component property names (JSON keys) from all components

tools.name: get_component_property_values
tools.description: Get values of a specific property for all components

tools.name: get_component_data
tools.description: Get all data for components in Altium

tools.name: get_component_pins
tools.description: Get pin data for components in Altium

tools.name: get_schematic_data
tools.description: Get schematic data for components in Altium

tools.name: create_schematic_symbol
tools.description: Create a new schematic symbol in the current library with the specified pins. Supports multi-part symbols via part_count and per-pin owner_part_id, plus active-low pin name overbar notation

tools.name: get_symbol_primitives
tools.description: Inventory a schematic library, or dump a symbol's complete geometry (graphics and pins, in mils)

tools.name: create_symbols_batch
tools.description: Create many schematic symbols in one script run from a plain-text spec file

tools.name: build_schematic
tools.description: Build a wired schematic on a new sheet from .SchLib parts, wires, junctions, net labels and power ports; returns each placed pin's connection point

tools.name: check_schematic
tools.description: Check saved schematic sheets for drafting problems: pin taps, label placement, text overlaps, dangling wires, slanted wires, pins off the grid, wires into ports, unconnected ports, single-pin nets

tools.name: apply_schematic_fixes
tools.description: Apply check_schematic's clear-cut label and part text suggestions to one saved sheet as one undo step, and save it

tools.name: check_hierarchy
tools.description: Check that sheet entries match the ports of their child sheets, harness types and harness definitions agree, and every signal harness has a type

tools.name: edit_schematic
tools.description: Change an existing schematic sheet as one undo step: move, place or delete parts, set parameters, move text, add wires, labels, power ports and junctions

tools.name: get_schematic_pins
tools.description: List a schematic sheet's pins live from Altium: connection point, number, name and electrical type

tools.name: get_symbol_placement_rules
tools.description: Get schematic symbol placement rules from a local configuration file

tools.name: get_library_symbol_reference
tools.description: Get the currently open symbol from a schematic library to use as reference for creating a new symbol

tools.name: search_library_symbol
tools.description: Search for a symbol by name in a schematic library (.SchLib) and navigate to it. Supports partial name matching; opens the library file if a path is provided or shows a file picker if not

tools.name: get_all_nets
tools.description: Return every unique net name in the active PCB document

tools.name: create_net_class
tools.description: Create a new net class and add specified nets to it

tools.name: get_pcb_layers
tools.description: Get detailed information about all layers in the current Altium PCB

tools.name: get_pcb_layer_stackup
tools.description: Get the detailed layer stackup information from the current Altium PCB including copper thickness, dielectric materials, constants, and heights

tools.name: set_pcb_layer_visibility
tools.description: Set visibility for specified PCB layers

tools.name: get_pcb_rules
tools.description: Get all design rules from the current Altium PCB

tools.name: create_pcb_rule
tools.description: Add a design rule (clearance, width, hole size, routing via, mask expansion or polygon connect) to a PCB

tools.name: run_drc
tools.description: Run the design rule check on a PCB and list the violations with measured values, optionally filtered by rule, net or area

tools.name: get_selected_components_coordinates
tools.description: Get coordinates and positioning information for selected components in Altium layout

tools.name: move_components
tools.description: Move selected components by specified X and Y offsets in the PCB layout

tools.name: set_component_position
tools.description: Set a component's absolute position (X, Y, rotation) in the PCB layout

tools.name: place_components
tools.description: Place any number of components at absolute positions (x, y, rotation, side, lock, designator and comment text) on a named board, in one undo step

tools.name: check_placement
tools.description: Find component overlaps and clearance violations using true primitive-to-primitive distances

tools.name: check_orientation
tools.description: Advisory check for 2-pad passives whose rotation could be improved

tools.name: get_net_connections
tools.description: For the nets touching the given components, list every pad on each net with airline (unrouted) lengths

tools.name: check_routing
tools.description: Find routed track segments that are not 0, 45 or 90 degrees, and right-angle or acute corners

tools.name: route_track
tools.description: Add a track through waypoints with every segment exactly 0, 45 or 90 degrees

tools.name: place_vias
tools.description: Add vias to a PCB at positions in mils, with nets and layer spans checked against the board first

tools.name: get_layout
tools.description: Read the layout of a group of components or an area: placement, texts, tracks, arcs, vias, fills, regions, cutouts and pours with their full outlines and settings, in place_copper's form

tools.name: place_copper
tools.description: Add tracks and arcs at any angle, vias, fills, regions, cutouts and polygon pours in one undo step, all checked first; can move and rename nets to repeat a layout

tools.name: get_unrouted_connections
tools.description: List the connections still to be routed for some components, nets or the whole board, naming the pads at each end, with no DRC limit

tools.name: fanout_pads
tools.description: Fan out pads to vias beside them (e.g. ground and power pads to their planes), widths and gaps from the board's rules

tools.name: route_connections
tools.description: Route a group's unrouted connections with a maze router at 0/45/90 degrees, widths and clearance from the board's rules, vias between the layers allowed

tools.name: delete_pcb_objects
tools.description: Rip up copper: tracks, arcs, vias, pours, regions, fills or cutouts picked by kind, net, layer, area or a group's designators; locked objects kept

tools.name: modify_pcb_objects
tools.description: Change the width, via size, net or layer of copper picked as for delete_pcb_objects, in one undo step

tools.name: place_polygon_pour
tools.description: Add a polygon pour from an outline to a PCB and pour it

tools.name: place_cutout
tools.description: Add a polygon pour cutout or a board cutout to a PCB and repour the polygons it overlaps

tools.name: repour_polygons
tools.description: Repour all polygon pours on a PCB, or those picked by name, net, layer or area, in pour order, as one undo step

tools.name: get_pour_report
tools.description: Report what each polygon pour poured: pieces, islands, slivers, and pours with no net or no copper

tools.name: layout_duplicator
tools.description: First step of layout duplication. Selects source components and returns data to match with destination components

tools.name: layout_duplicator_apply
tools.description: Second step of layout duplication. Applies the layout of source components to destination components

tools.name: auto_place_silkscreen
tools.description: Bulk-place designators with the Silkscreen Auto Placer script, run headless inside Altium in one undo step

tools.name: check_silkscreen
tools.description: Find designators that need work: Altium's own silk rules plus quality checks such as far from the part, ambiguous, over a body or upside down

tools.name: view_silkscreen
tools.description: Render the silkscreen around some designators or in a region, with a grid labelled in board coordinates

tools.name: get_designator_options
tools.description: Ranked legal spots for designators, drawn as numbered boxes

tools.name: get_label_block_options
tools.description: Options for placing a row of parts' designators together as a block, linked to the parts by a leader line or index markers

tools.name: place_label_block
tools.description: Apply a label block: move the designators into it, draw its link, and check both with Altium's silk rules

tools.name: remove_label_block
tools.description: Remove the label block of some parts: delete its link graphics and leave the designators where they are

tools.name: set_designator_positions
tools.description: Place designators by coordinates or relative to their part, and get Altium's DRC verdict for each

tools.name: create_pcb_footprint
tools.description: Create a new PCB footprint in the currently active PcbLib document with SMD pads, auto-generated courtyard, and silkscreen with pin 1 indicator

tools.name: get_footprint_primitives
tools.description: Inventory a PCB library, or dump footprint geometry (pads with full stack and hole detail, tracks, arcs, fills, texts, regions)

tools.name: create_footprints_batch
tools.description: Create many PCB footprints in one script run from a plain-text spec file

tools.name: get_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of one named thing in Altium: the window, a document, a dialog, a panel or a screen region

tools.name: run_altium_script
tools.description: Run a DelphiScript snippet in an isolated sandbox and get a step-by-step log, its result, and the statement that failed

tools.name: ensure_altium_script_skill
tools.description: Check whether the altium-script skill (Altium DelphiScript API reference) is installed, and install it on request

tools.name: get_server_status
tools.description: Get the current status of the Altium MCP server
